sentences.text: December's full moon also falls near perigee: slightly smaller than November's, but still one of the largest of the year.
The Moon is now less than three hundred sixty thousand kilometres from Earth.
The winter full moon is the one that climbs highest in the northern sky; in the days when the Sun stays low, the Moon opposite it rides high.
The December full moon is called the Cold Moon; it marks the start of the long winter nights.
Seen from Earth it shines in Gemini, right beside the radiant of the Geminids.
